from typing import Any, Dict

def deep_dict_update(main_dict: Dict[Any, Any], update_dict: Dict[Any, Any]) -> None:
    """
    Recursively updates main_dict with the contents of update_dict.
    If a key in update_dict is already in main_dict and both values are dictionaries,
    it will recursively update the dictionary in main_dict.
    Otherwise, it will overwrite the value in main_dict with the value from update_dict.
    """
    for key, value in update_dict.items():
        if key in main_dict and isinstance(main_dict[key], dict) and isinstance(value, dict):
            deep_dict_update(main_dict[key], value)
        else:
            main_dict[key] = value
